comment: Closed registry of gating/driver tags (ADR-0015). World and Mind emit a tag set each moment; conditional content declares required `tags` and forbidden `not_tags`. A family with `pattern` accepts any value matching it; otherwise `values` is the closed list.

description.en: Days spent inside the region (cumulative: N present means day N or more)
